summary: Unauthenticated WebSocket PTY shell exposed by ui-tools
details: Package advertised as a React UI-components library ships a server-side hook `useTerminal` that opens a WebSocketServer, spawns a bash/powershell PTY via `pty.spawn(shell, shellArgs, { cwd: process.env.HOME || os.homedir(), env: {...process.env } })`, and pipes bytes received from ws `message` events directly into `ptyProcess.write(parsed.data)` with no authentication or origin check on the WebSocket endpoint. Any remote client able to reach the mounted `/terminal-stream` path obtains an interactive shell running as the process user, with the user's home directory as cwd and full environment inherited. The library-shape name and README do not disclose that consuming the package as documented mounts a remote-shell endpoint on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
